title: GeoPulse 2.0.0
highlights: REST API fully reimplemented under /api/v1 with consistent endpoints, request/response schemas and structured error responses
Localization support: GeoPulse is now available in English and Ukrainian, with more languages to come
Refreshed UI across almost every page, backed by a global CSS and theming cleanup with consistent dark mode
Timeline map: 3D map support and customizable map appearance, including path and highlighted path colors
Trip Plans: place discovery with photos, per-stop travel mode with routed legs, and a reworked Trip Workspace
Added Public Transport trip type and the option to disable map matching for specific trip types
New notifications for new releases, missing GPS data, ready Rewinds and backups
Shared links: auto-refresh and auto-follow, Immich photos with album restriction
Period Tags are renamed to Timeline Labels
Better observability: structured JSON logs, request IDs and log level changes from the Admin panel
Upgraded to Quarkus 3.40 LTS, with many internal fixes and improvements

title: GeoPulse 1.39.0
highlights: Added MCP server support for read-only access to timelines, stays, trips, route statistics, and shared friend data
Added manual trip splitting to insert a missed stay and retain it during timeline regeneration
Added Panoramax street-level imagery integration for timeline maps
Collapsed map controls into a "More..." menu on mobile devices
Fixed map matching for ongoing trips
Updated documentation for MCP, Panoramax, and manual trip splitting

title: GeoPulse 1.38.1
highlights: Fixed regression from release 1.38.0 related to Reverse Geocoding reconciliation UI

title: GeoPulse 1.38.0
highlights: Added Map Matching functionality with Valhalla integration
Added System Backup and Restore from Admin UI
Shared live or timeline page can be fully embedded to other websites
Allow to add Custom Reverse Geocoding providers with Nominatim or Photon compatible API
Fixed MultiPoint GeoJSON support to match Colota implementation

title: GeoPulse 1.37.1
highlights: Added separate distance and temperature unit preferences
Added GeoJSON MultiPoint import support
Improved Timeline context menus on mobile
Added Helm configuration for backend deployment strategy
Fixed TinyAuth/OIDC login and account-linking behavior

title: GeoPulse 1.37.0
highlights: Added "Show GPS Points" context menu on Stays and Trips
Added "Was I here?" context menu on Timeline map to find all visits to any place on the map
Added Pirate Weather provider
Optimized Weather internal implementation
Improved Immich Photo Viewer and Gallery
Fixed highlighted trip popup to respect metric units
Updated Unraid documentation

title: GeoPulse 1.36.3
highlights: Added support for DEMO mode. Stay tuned, public demo instance will be provided soon
UI improvements on mobile devices
Added option to use encryption secret for OwnTracks messages so GeoPulse can decrtypt the messages encypted by OwnTracks
Increased max allowed speed for bicycles from 50 to 80 km/h

title: GeoPulse 1.36.2
highlights: Fixed Memos integration for latest Memos instances - breaking change by Memos
Fixed Immich UI saving issue
Fixed stale UI cache issues after deployment
Added instructions for unRAID
Improved Weather integration to reduce CPU usage
Adjusted OwnTracks export and import formats to support ocat tool
Added long press (right click alternative) on mobile on Timeline cards
Documentation improvements

title: GeoPulse 1.36.1
highlights: Emergency fix for GPS integration REST endpoints returning 404 in 1.36.0 Docker and native deployments
Restored OwnTracks, Colota, GPS Logger, Traccar, Home Assistant, and Overland ingestion endpoints

title: GeoPulse 1.36.0
highlights: Added Weather integration with Timeline, map, Journey Insights, badges, admin status, and Open-Meteo configuration
Ongoing weather is captured by default; historical weather requires GEOPULSE_WEATHER_BACKFILL_ENABLED=true or Admin panel opt-in
Added Notes integration with GeoPulse notes and Memos sync on Timeline, maps, place details, and shared timelines
Set up Memos from Menu -> Profile -> Notes with server URL, API key, default save destination, visibility, cache, and tag filters
Kubernetes Helm deployments now support Gateway API HTTPRoute, extra environment variables, and extra volume mounts
Improved large exports, coverage processing, and water-aware timeline regeneration performance
Fixed map zoom and navigation edge cases, Trip Workspace interactions, City/Country visit links, and Immich US country matching
Other UI and performance improvements

title: GeoPulse 1.35.1
highlights: Added Pull To Refresh functionality to PWA on GPS Data page
Raw GPS points map layer now respects GPS accuracy settings
Added separate transaction timeout for Import process, so very long import sessions will not fail due to timeout
Various UI fixes on GPS Data page
